review_comment: The patch adds ordering support to StringAgg by interpolating ordering expressions directly into the SQL template without parameterization. While ordering expressions are processed through Django's as_sql() method, the final string interpolation bypasses proper SQL parameterization. To prevent potential injection, ensure ordering expressions are either fully validated before processing or use parameterized placeholders for any user-influenced content in the template.

The template modification adds ordering capability to ArrayAgg by including %(ordering)s in the SQL template. While Django's expression system typically handles SQL escaping, verify that ordering expressions processed through OrderableAggMixin maintain proper neutralization of SQL special characters. Ensure ordering parameters are validated and escaped before template interpolation to prevent potential injection vectors.
